M1.title: Authenticated tailnet chat stream proof
M1.outcome: From Expo Go on the phone, over the tailnet only, a user can send one prompt to the currently resident Ollama model and watch the reply stream in token by token, protected by a bearer token, with Stop working.

review_override.reason: Human authorised a third fix cycle beyond the 2-cycle cap (cycle 5) to fix the cycle-5 review's IMPORTANT finding: FR13 401 handling must show 'password wrong or changed' and route to Settings.

as_built.result: RECORDED — 62/62 files attributed; components C1,C2,C3,C4,C6,C7,C8,C9,C10,C11; 12 edges; 2 claim mismatches (C5 claimed but not in diff, deferred to M2 per code comments; C3 present but not claimed)

criteria.text: With a model already resident in Ollama, sending a prompt from the Expo Go app over Tailscale Serve renders the reply incrementally, token by token, ending in a terminal complete state.
evidence: e2e-tailnet-proof.sh (live, tailnet URL :8443): 80 content events over ~6.5s ending done status complete — .harness/evidence/M1-T5b-verifier.log
server.test.ts chat streams content then complete — .harness/evidence/M1-T7-verifier.log
On-phone Expo Go rendering: human check, not yet done

HUMAN CHECK 2026-09-25 (after cycle-2 review, finding B): on the iPhone with Tailscale ON, Expo Go opened exp://ryans-mac-studio.tailc3648a.ts.net:8081, hung on 'Opening project', then showed 'Unmatched Route'. The app did not reach the chat or Settings screens; token paste, streaming and Stop could not be tried. FAIL.

CYCLE-2 FIX (M1-C6, commit 1a7565e): cause of 'Unmatched Route' was that mobile/src/app had no index.tsx, so the root path Expo Go opens matched no screen. Added index.tsx redirecting to /setup (no token) or /chat (token); bundle host restarted; the tailnet-served bundle registers ./index.tsx. The ~20s 'Opening project' wait matches the first production bundle build (bundle-host.log: 'iOS Bundled 23140ms'). On-phone re-test by the human: pending.

HUMAN CHECK 2026-09-25 (re-test after fix cycle 2): on the iPhone with Tailscale ON, Expo Go opened the app and reached the Setup screen (Unmatched Route is fixed). On Setup, the on-screen keyboard covers the submit (Continue) button and does not dismiss when tapping outside the input; the human could not get past Setup. Chat, Settings, streaming and Stop could not be tried. FAIL.

CYCLE-3 FIX (M1-C9 81d49c6, M1-C10 61421a3): Setup, Settings and Chat now move their content above the keyboard (KeyboardAvoidingView; Setup/Settings offset by the header height), tapping or dragging outside the input dismisses it, and the token field is single-line with a Done key that submits. Chat's duplicate top bar removed. Bundle host restarted; tailnet-served bundle carries the change. On-phone re-test by the human: pending.

HUMAN CHECK 2026-09-25 15:51 (re-test after fix cycle 3; screenshots in ~/.claude/uploads/a2032993-e031-4e36-92d7-4ddfdde26a07/): Setup PASSED - the token was pasted and Continue reached Chat. Chat: the human sent 'Test' and received the reply 'Hello! How can I assist you today?' (the end-to-end send and reply work on the phone). FAIL: on Chat, the keyboard covers the message input box. Chat still shows two top bars (a Stack header 'chat' above the screen's own 'Chat / Settings' bar), although M1-C9 claimed to hide the Stack header. Settings opens (Stack header '< chat' / 'settings', with Cancel, Save and Logout); keyboard behaviour on Settings was not reported. Token-by-token rendering and Stop not yet reported.

HUMAN CHECK 2026-09-25 15:53 (after a full force-close and reopen of Expo Go; screenshot ~/.claude/uploads/a2032993-e031-4e36-92d7-4ddfdde26a07/1eae7b80-image.png): the app now fails at launch with the Expo Go error screen: 'There was a problem running "Phone Models". Unhandled JS Exception: TypeError: Cannot convert Symbol to string', stack: anonymous (expo-router.bundle ... :60047:56) < RootLayout (:58345:55) < WrappedScreenComponent (:76671:49) < Suspense < ZoomTransitionTargetContextProvider. This suggests the 15:51 run was a cached pre-cycle-3 bundle (two top bars on Chat), and the current cycle-3 bundle crashes in RootLayout. FAIL.

CYCLE-4 FIX (M1-C11 6fec6a1, M1-C12 49bb53f, M1-C13 0376cf3): launch crash on every launch with a stored token fixed (Fragment inside RootLayout's <Stack>; present since d87a597); Chat/Settings now always get their declared options, so after first-time Setup Chat has one top bar and its keyboard offset premise (no Stack header) holds. New runtime check `cd mobile && bun run smoke:runtime` executes the production iOS bundle in Node with fake native modules: proves launch + first screen render without a JS exception for token present (Chat) and absent (Setup), and the Setup -> Chat path with one top bar; cannot prove Hermes-only behaviour, native layout/keyboard geometry, or anything past first screens. Bundle host restarted; served bundle passes the runtime check. On-phone re-test by the human: pending.

HUMAN CHECK 2026-09-25 (re-test after fix cycle 4, iPhone with Tailscale ON, all eight recorded cycle-4 steps): the human reported 'All working'. AC1 steps: fresh force-close/reopen landed on Chat with no error; one top bar; message box and Send stayed above the keyboard; a short prompt streamed word by word and finished; second force-close/reopen landed directly on Chat. PASS.
Final review cycle 6 (sonnet, 650e350): PASS; independent re-run in .harness/evidence/M1-cycle6-review.log

Note: e2e-tailnet-proof.sh run on the Mac itself still reports LAN 192.168.0.27:8081 REACHABLE (HTTP 200) after install; the Mac-local probe may not exercise the LAN path (unconfirmed).

M10c4.title: Broad web questions draw on at least three different websites
M10c4.outcome: With the web switch on, the instructions the server gives the model alongside the FR19 date note tell it that a broad or open-ended question is searched with more than one query, without the exact date in the query, reading pages from at least three different websites before answering, and citing the pages it read by number, while a narrow question need not search more than it needs; the server does not check or re-prompt and the 10-call cap is unchanged. Each page the model reads in a reply gets a number (first-read order); the page text is labelled with it and the saved sources carry it, and the app shows a citation mark such as [2] as that page's logo opening its exact saved URL (FR31), deterministically, so a logo never depends on the model copying a URL. Proven live on the Mac: most broad prompts come back with sources from three or more sites, each cited so that it shows a logo. Planned 2026-09-30 from the owner-reported follow-ups under M10c1; FR31 added 2026-09-30 by human decision resolving this milestone's BLOCKED escalation (the planner may re-check size/shape: it now spans server and phone).

M19b.title: Every deep research model call is logged, thinks only at plan and write, and is time-capped
M19b.outcome: Through POST /v1/chat, every deep research model call writes one structured log line with the FR41 fields; loading the deep-research model sends the research num_ctx so the first research call does not rebuild the runner; brief, query proposal, page choice, notes and gap check are sent with think:false, an output cap, non-thinking sampling and a hard wall-clock cap; plan and write keep thinking, streamed, under a time guard and are re-issued once with think:false when it is exceeded. Human decision 2026-10-02: built before M20; M20 and M21 stay TODO after these milestones; M5a stays BLOCKED, untouched. Split at planning into M19b-M19h: the FR41-FR45 work as one milestone would carry 15+ criteria and signals CONCURRENCY_LIFECYCLE (per-call caps and guards, parallel prefetch, per-outage resume), IMPLEMENTATION_PLUS_LIVE_PROOF (AC32, AC33), SUBSYSTEMS_GT_3 (C1, C2, C4, C5, C6, C7, C12), MULTIPLE_OUTCOMES and WORKER_TASKS_GT_6; parts: M19b model-call measurement, thinking and caps (FR41, FR42); M19c passages (FR43); M19d breadth first, prefetch, partial notes (FR44); M19e server liveness (FR45 server half); M19f phone liveness (FR45 app half); M19g live Mac proof (AC32); M19h live phone proof (AC33). This part keeps one signal: CONCURRENCY_LIFECYCLE (cancelling a call at its cap or guard and re-issuing it; seam check: FR41's logging is the measurement the caps are judged by and the warm-up num_ctx is one request field, so splitting them off leaves halves too small to review alone) - not split further.
